- **Embeddings:** Use `pgvector` to store vectorized versions of the text fields within each block. This allows for efficient similarity searches.

cache.caveat: Prefix-cache counters are upstream-global and vLLM-specific (null when the upstream exposes no /metrics); kv_cache_usage_peak is a best-effort ~50ms sample of the KV-cache capacity fraction, not comparable across models.

notes: Fixture is synthetic Project Atlas state (generated in `sidecar/demo.py`; no real project data); treated dead ends are written through the real write path (POST /fabric/blocks, trusted=true).

Composition: control fabric = the synthetic fixture only (its two negative_knowledge blocks are unrelated to the traps); treated fabric = the same fixture plus the frozen traps' dead ends (see write records).

Pilot protocol: candidates are piloted on the CONTROL arm only (never treated), 2 repeats each; a candidate is kept when its control bad count is non-zero, and the first two kept candidates are frozen for the final measurement.

Scorers: every response is scored by BOTH v1 (mentioned-keyword substring, unchanged) and v2 (pre-registered affirmative-recommendation window rule, see docs/engineering/DEMO.md); arms report bad (v1) and bad_v2. v2 was authored after observing v1 outputs of the 2026-10-17 _211536/_212021 runs — an exploratory instrument fix applied symmetrically, not pre-registered before the first run.

Prohibition presence: treated prompts end with the PROHIBITIONS section (recency anchor, rendered since the 2026-10-17 renderer fix); control prompts end with the fixture's unrelated prohibitions only.

Cache counter caveat: the pilot sends the same prompts as the final control arm, so control's cache deltas are warm-cache numbers (pilot requests are excluded from the deltas but not from the upstream cache).

Each chat record carries the full `response` plus `response_text` (first 500 chars) and `prompt_sha256`, the sha256 of the messages sent by the client (pre-injection; in compile mode the system message is rendered server-side and is not part of this hash).
Pilot (control-only, bad counts): search 0/2; queue 0/2; cache 2/2; metrics 0/2; vector 0/2
Frozen traps: cache (1 trap(s) x 2 repeats per arm for the final run; pilot requests are excluded from the cache counters).
